items.title: Slide Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: Yes from that man. All you have to do is look at those scores. You can learn everything about orchestration.

ctx.x: So you can learn, you know, you can learn from—
Yes from that man. All you have to do is look at those scores. You can learn everything about orchestration. Because that guy was really rough man. What was going on in his mind, I’m telling you.
Boy what he could have done with the Ellington band.
